literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) document C-terminal HA or myc tags on full-length LRRN1. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, the intracellular domain spans residues 653–716 (last residue W716), placing every C-terminal tag on the cytoplasmic face. No ledger line reports an N-terminal tag (which would need to follow the signal-peptide cleavage at residue 25 to reach the extracellular face) or any internal extracellular insertion. Because no ledger evidence supports an extracellular tag site, sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA and myc tags appended after W716 (last residue of the intracellular domain, 653–716); confirmed expressed on-cell (L2) and functional (L3), but the tag itself faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
